:::{#def-logistic-function}
#### Logistic function (also called the sigmoid or expit)

The **logistic function**, also called the **sigmoid** or **expit**, is
the [function](#def-function) $\sigmoid : \reals \to (0, 1)$ with
[@wikipedia_logistic_function]

$$\sigmoidf{z} \eqdef \frac{1}{1 + e^{-z}}.$$

:::
